title: Mussel Goo as Glue
content:
Abstract
Skin grafting is a critical component for healing damaged skin when the damage is extensive. Engraftment requires adhering replacement tissue over the damaged area. Traditional adherence methods, such as stapling or suturing the replacement in place, can produce additional damage and complicate healing. Researchers at Pohang University of Science and Technology have developed an adhesive mixture with superior properties for attaching skin grafts and promoting wound healing. The mixture is based on polymers derived from mussels.
